search.text: Searches every saved character, online or not, by citizen ID, character name, account name or license. Shows the first 60 matches.

characters.filterAll: Shows every character the search found. Changes nothing on the server.
characters.filterOnline: Shows only characters whose player is in the server now, each with its session number (#).
characters.filterOffline: Shows characters that are not online. You can still change their money and job; it waits in their data until the player joins.
characters.filterBlocked: Shows suspended characters that their players cannot play until you lift the suspension.
characters.clearSearch: Clears the search and shows the most recently played characters again.
characters.colId: The character's fixed citizen ID, with its session number (#) beside it when online now.
characters.colName: The character's in-game name, with the account name of the player who owns it under it.
characters.colJob: The character's current job. Change it in the Money & job tab.
characters.colState: Online now or offline, and Suspended when it may not be played.
characters.colLast: The last time the character's data was saved, roughly when its player last played it. Server time.
characters.colLicense: The player's Rockstar license, the same for all their characters. It tells you which characters belong to one player.

colSlot.text: The character's slot on the player's character selection screen.

characters.reportDelete: Summary of the last deletion: what each script removed, how much money went back to the reserve, and whether the number is free. It stays until you hide it.
characters.reportTransfer: Result of the last number transfer: who took the number and where its holder went. If it stopped half way it tells you what to do. It stays until you hide it.
characters.openReported: Opens this character's file in the side panel so you can see how it is now. Changes nothing.
characters.drawer: The selected character's file. The tabs hold its details, where its data lives, money and job, suspension, its citizen ID and deletion.
characters.tabOverview: The character's details: IDs, account, job, balances and the account's other characters. Read only.
characters.tabLinks: Where the server keeps the character's data, grouped by what a deletion would do to it. Read only.
characters.tabEconomy: Gives the character money or an item, or changes its job and gang, whether it is online or not.
characters.tabAccess: Suspends the character so its player cannot play it, or lifts the suspension.
characters.tabIdentity: Changes the character's citizen ID, or hands its number to another character.
characters.tabDanger: Deletes the character and its data for good. It cannot be undone.
characters.kvCitizenId: This character's fixed citizen ID. It only changes if you change it in the Identity tab. Copy it to paste into a command or a message.
characters.kvState: Online now with its session number (#), or offline. Changes to an offline character are saved to its data.
characters.kvAccount: The name of the player account that owns the character, like their RedM name.
characters.kvGang: The gang the character belongs to now. Change it in the Money & job tab.
characters.balances: The character's balances in the central bank now: cash, bank and gold. Change cash and gold in the Money & job tab.
characters.siblings: Other characters on the same account, so the same player. Press one to open its file.
characters.offline: The character is offline: changes are saved to its data and its player finds them on joining.
characters.links: Where the server keeps the character's data, grouped by what a deletion does to it. The number is how many records.
characters.kindCore: The character itself and its bank accounts. A deletion removes them and every balance goes back to the reserve.
characters.kindData: Things only this character uses, like its looks, bag and horses. A deletion removes them for good.
characters.kindAsset: Property such as a house or a store. A deletion returns it to the game: the house goes back on sale, the store back to the government.
characters.kindHistory: Old records like bank movements. They stay after a deletion, filed as deleted instead of under the character's number.
characters.kindOther: Data its own script handles in its own way when the character is deleted.
characters.techDetails: Shows the database table and column names for each group. Only useful to a developer; it changes nothing.
characters.moneySafe: Where the character's money goes on deletion: it is not lost, it all returns to the reserve through the central bank.

money.text: Adds cash or gold to the character or takes it away. Online, they see it at once; offline, it is saved to their data.
money.undo: Yes, with the opposite operation for the same amount

characters.moneyType: Cash is the money in the character's pocket and gold is gold bars. The bank balance is changed from the central bank itself.
characters.moneyOp: Add raises the balance; Take away lowers it by the same amount.

amount.text: How much to add or take away, from 0.01 to 1000000000. Up to two decimals are fine.
amount.example: 250 with cash means $250; 2.5 with gold means two and a half gold

characters.moneyReason: Why you add the money. It is kept in the admin log; only adding needs it, because the money comes out of the central bank reserve.

moneyApply.text: Carries out the operation now and writes it to the admin log.

characters.item: Gives the character an item in its bag. If it is offline, the item is added to its saved bag.
characters.itemPick: The item to give. Search by name; the small name under it is what scripts call it.

itemCount.text: How many to give, from 1 to 1000.

itemGive.text: Gives the item now. If it does not arrive, a message tells you why.
itemGive.undo: No, there is no take-back here

job.text: Changes the character's job and rank in it. Online, it changes at once; offline, on its next join.
job.undo: Yes, pick the old job and apply it

characters.jobPick: The new job. Search by its name.

grade.text: The rank inside the job or gang. 0 is the lowest; a higher number usually means more rights.

characters.jobApply: Saves the chosen job and rank now.

gang.text: Changes the character's gang and rank in it. Online, it changes at once; offline, on its next join.
gang.undo: Yes, pick the old gang and apply it

characters.gangPick: The new gang. Search by its name.
characters.gangApply: Saves the chosen gang and rank now.

access.text: Stops this one character from being played: its player sees 'contact the administration', and their other characters stay available.

blockReason.text: The player sees the reason when trying to join with the character, and it is kept in the log.

block.text: Suspends the character now. If it is playing, it is kicked at once and sees the reason.

characters.unblock: Lifts the suspension so the player can join with this character again right away.
characters.blocked: This character is suspended now: the reason, who suspended it and when.

reassign.text: Gives the character a new citizen ID you choose. All its data moves with it and its old number becomes free. It must be offline.

newId.text: The new number: digits only, 1 to 9 of them, and not held by another character.

characters.newIdTaken: Another character holds the number you typed now, so it cannot go to this one. Pick another number.
characters.openHolder: Opens the file of the character that holds the number; from its Identity tab you can hand its number to this character.

reassignApply.text: Changes the number now. Its player sees the new number on the next join.
reassignApply.undo: Yes, change it back to its old number while that is still free

characters.transfer: Gives this character's number to another character. The holder moves to a fresh number with everything it has; nothing passes between them. Both are kicked if online.

transferTarget.text: The citizen ID of the character that takes the number, or # and the session number if it is online. Its name shows under the field so you can check.

characters.transferSides: Who the transfer affects: the holder moves to a fresh number, and the other character takes this one.

transferApply.text: Opens the confirm window: type the number there and the whole transfer runs in one go.
transferApply.undo: Not with one press; move it back with another transfer

characters.transferNumeric: Only sequential numbers like 14 can be handed on. This character has an old ID like OMG95204, so give it a new number first with Change citizen ID.
characters.delete: Deletes the character for good; its property returns to the game and its money to the reserve. Cannot be undone; type the citizen ID to confirm.
characters.deleteSummary: What would happen to this character's data if you delete it, from what we found now.
characters.deleteStart: Opens the confirm window. Type the citizen ID there and the deletion starts. If the character is online it is kicked first and its logout saved.
characters.refusal: A script refused the deletion, so everything stopped. Fix the reason shown, then try again; deleting again is safe and repeats nothing.
characters.openPlayer: Opens this player on the Players page so you can go to them, bring them or heal them. Works only while the character is online.
characters.reload: Fetches the character's data from the server again.

characters.noLinks: Nothing is linked to this character
characters.blockAskText: Its player cannot play it until you lift the suspension. If it is online now it is kicked and sees the reason.
characters.reassignAskText: From %s to %s. All its data moves to the new number and number %s becomes free.
characters.transferKick: Whichever of them is online is kicked from the game first.
characters.sumCore: The character and its bank accounts are deleted
characters.transferOldTitle: An old ID cannot be handed on
characters.transferOldText: Give it a new number first with Change citizen ID above; then you can hand its number on.
